decision.reason: Generic references reduce raw snapshot bytes but increase encoding/roundtrip CPU; the already packed SQLite bodies become larger, including after gzip. This cost diagnostic did not enter production end-to-end acceptance.
decision.thresholdEvidence: No frozen numeric acceptance thresholds or gate verdict exist in the retained reports or prototype harness. No threshold is inferred from later experiments.

measurement.samples: Three real immutable snapshots per 2p/4p fixture, plus one nested provisional snapshot; raw, JSON-adapter and actual pre-stringification SQLite-packed representations.
measurement.cpuScope: process.cpuUsage inside each timed loop; incidental GC included, setup and explicit pre-loop full GC excluded. This is per-operation CPU, not full-workload CPU.
measurement.bundleMethod: Equal-weight three-snapshot bundles; per-process summed per-op timings. Not full workload, SQLite I/O or action-to-broadcast latency. Negative change means improvement.
measurement.changePercentMethod: For each process sum the three sample per-op values, compute 100*(reference/json-1), then summarize across five processes. This need not equal a ratio of separately summarized medians.
measurement.rssScope: Mixed-case process peak RSS is retained as context and is not a per-codec comparison.
measurement.reconstructedInvocation: node --expose-gc --import tsx scripts/bench/reference-codec-prototype/run.ts --round N --target-ms 120 --output OUTPUT; add --verify for correctness. Run in the recorded 2 CPU / 2 GiB cgroup. Reconstructed from run.ts, not represented as a retained original shell invocation.

edges.note: Decoded alias graphs are intentionally mutable; rule-state isolation is tested after import/rehydrate in snapshot correctness.

strict.scope: Full canonical Frame/cursor equivalence and semantic commit classification between JSON and reference transports, with both restored after every command. This is not the uninterrupted production trace and does not validate SQLite Step storage, persistence I/O or broadcast.

trusted.scope: Full canonical Frame/cursor equivalence and semantic commit classification between JSON and reference transports, with both restored after every command. This is not the uninterrupted production trace and does not validate SQLite Step storage, persistence I/O or broadcast.

limitations: JSON-adapter comparison uses alias-path catalogs for JSON and identity-deduplicated catalogs for references; both restore the same logical state/Frame/cursor.
Correctness restores both variants after every command; it is not the uninterrupted production trace and does not validate actual SQLite Replay Step storage.
Packed setup calls RoomHistoryStore.prepare without SQL, outside timing; history-node rows, recovery-body and SQL-page write costs are not inferred from the latest packed-value codec measurements.
Decoded references preserve mutable aliases; writable rules isolation depends on the existing recovery import and rehydrateState boundary.
Finite sample costs do not prove that every future reference codec or wire layout is unsuitable.

encoding.method: Each rawFiles entry independently gzip-compresses the original bytes with mtime=0, then base64-encodes them. Decode base64, gunzip, verify bytes and sha256. JSON fields, unknown fields, original whitespace, reports, source and logs are all retained.
